2: To the Overseer with stringed instruments. --A Psalm of Asaph. --A Song. In Judah is God known, in Israel His name is great.
3: And His tabernacle is in Salem, And His habitation in Zion.
4: There he hath shivered arrows of a bow, Shield, and sword, and battle. Selah.
5: Bright art Thou, honourable above hills of prey.
6: Spoiled themselves have the mighty of heart, They have slept their sleep, And none of the men of might found their hands.
7: From Thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, Both rider and horse have been fast asleep.
8: Thou, fearful art Thou, And who doth stand before Thee, Since Thou hast been angry!
9: From heaven Thou hast sounded judgment, Earth hath feared, and hath been still,
10: In the rising of God to judgment, To save all the humble of earth. Selah.
11: For the fierceness of man praiseth Thee, The remnant of fierceness Thou girdest on.
12: Vow and complete to Jehovah your God, All ye surrounding him. They bring presents to the Fearful One.
13: He doth gather the spirit of leaders, Fearful to the kings of earth!
